verdict.rationale: Firebase exposes broad API/CLI/MCP surface (firebase-tools CLI for deploy/hosting/auth/data, Admin & REST SDKs, and an official MCP server letting AI agents create projects, manage auth, work with Firestore/SQL Connect and messaging), giving an AI-native user substantial parity with the console. However, no OpenAPI/llms.txt spec was found (404s), and community feedback flags real API gaps versus the console (e.g., no count queries, limited server-side query options, storage rules must be reimplemented outside the API), so full UI parity isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, evidence of full parity for console-only features (billing, project settings), and resolution of documented query/feature gaps.
